stem: The tracking platform is offline during an authorized plant movement, and the facility has a controlled downtime form. What is the best response?
choices: Record the event using the approved downtime method and reconcile when the system returns
Wait until the end of the week and enter movements from memory
Move the plants without any record because the system is unavailable
Create a personal spreadsheet that is not part of the controlled process
rationale: A controlled downtime process preserves contemporaneous identity and event information when the primary platform is unavailable.
